evals.name: evidence-cited-and-masked

evals.expected_output: Produces the four-part Structured Opportunity (evidence, hypothesis, impact estimate, recommended action). Every evidence line cites its provenance reference from the supplied record (zendesk:tkt-3391, gong:call-4981, reops:study-rn-2026-09:fnd-0017). Attributes the 41% chase rate and the 12-minute median only to reops:study-rn-2026-09:fnd-0017; does not claim the Zendesk ticket or Gong call supports those figures, and does not cite zendesk:view-renewal-audit-2026-09 (listed only as an originating source, with no evidence record) as support for any finding. Quotes at most the fragment the recommended action needs from the supplied synthetic excerpt; all other evidence appears as masked references, not reproduced text. Labels the record synthetic/supplied and does not claim a live graph read.

evals.name: impact-baseline-applies-chase-rate
evals.prompt: Estimate the impact for PRB-104 from the supplied inputs.
evals.expected_output: Applies the 41% manual-chase rate to the 4,200 quarterly renewal reviews before costing them: about 1,722 chased reviews x 12 minutes = about 344 agent-hours x $45 = about $15,498 per quarter, presented as the modeled baseline cost of manual chasing. Does not cost all 4,200 reviews (about $37,800 per quarter). Notes the 12 minutes is a median used as a stand-in for a mean. Does not present the baseline as achievable savings: any savings figure rests on an explicit reduction assumption marked [A], or savings are stated as TBD. Does not invent numeric bounds; a range is either TBD with the missing inputs named, or given as clearly labeled scenarios each stating its assumption. Distinguishes inputs cited to the study finding from inputs supplied without an evidence reference, and labels them synthetic/supplied.
